WITH plandata AS ( SELECT prod_plan_date, sum(prod_plan_qty) total_plan_qty from production_plan pp join item i on (pp.item_id = i.item_id)
i.item_name = #{searchItem}
GROUP BY prod_plan_date ), workdata AS ( SELECT pp.prod_plan_date, sum(wo.order_qty) total_order_qty FROM production_plan pp JOIN WORK_ORDER wo on(pp.prod_plan_id=wo.prod_plan_id) join item i on(pp.item_id = i.item_id)
i.item_name = #{searchItem}
group BY pp.prod_plan_date ), defectdate AS ( SELECT pp.prod_plan_date, sum(dl.defect_qty) total_defect_qty FROM production_plan pp JOIN work_order wo on(pp.prod_plan_id = wo.prod_plan_id) JOIN production p on(wo.order_id = p.order_id) JOIN inspection i on(p.prod_id = i.prod_id) JOIN DEFECT_LIST dl on(i.insp_id = dl.insp_id) join item it on(pp.item_id = it.item_id)
it.item_name = #{searchItem}
GROUP BY pp.prod_plan_date )
SELECT to_char(p.prod_plan_date,'YYYY-IW') 계획일자, round(avg(total_plan_qty),1) 생산계획량, round(avg(nvl(w.total_order_qty,0)),1) 작업량, round(avg(nvl(d.total_defect_qty,0)),1) 불량수량 FROM plandata p LEFT OUTER JOIN workdata w ON p.prod_plan_date = w.PROD_PLAN_DATE LEFT OUTER JOIN defectdate d ON p.prod_plan_date = d.prod_plan_date GROUP BY to_char(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-IW') ORDER BY 계획일자
SELECT to_char(p.prod_plan_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') 계획일자, total_plan_qty 생산계획량, nvl(w.total_order_qty,0) 작업량, nvl(d.total_defect_qty,0) 불량수량 FROM plandata p LEFT OUTER JOIN workdata w ON p.prod_plan_date = w.PROD_PLAN_DATE LEFT OUTER JOIN defectdate d ON p.prod_plan_date = d.prod_plan_date ORDER BY p.prod_plan_date
SELECT to_char(p.prod_plan_date,'YYYY') 계획일자, sum(total_plan_qty) 생산계획량, sum(nvl(w.total_order_qty,0)) 작업량, sum(nvl(d.total_defect_qty,0)) 불량수량 FROM plandata p LEFT OUTER JOIN workdata w ON p.prod_plan_date = w.PROD_PLAN_DATE LEFT OUTER JOIN defectdate d ON p.prod_plan_date = d.prod_plan_date GROUP BY to_char(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY') ORDER BY 계획일자
SELECT to_char(p.prod_plan_date,'YYYY') 계획일자, round(avg(total_plan_qty),1) 생산계획량, round(avg(nvl(w.total_order_qty,0)),1) 작업량, round(avg(nvl(d.total_defect_qty,0)),1) 불량수량 FROM plandata p LEFT OUTER JOIN workdata w ON p.prod_plan_date = w.PROD_PLAN_DATE LEFT OUTER JOIN defectdate d ON p.prod_plan_date = d.prod_plan_date GROUP BY to_char(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY') ORDER BY 계획일자
SELECT to_char(p.prod_plan_date,'YYYY-MM') 계획일자, round(avg(total_plan_qty),1) 생산계획량, round(avg(nvl(w.total_order_qty,0)),1) 작업량, round(avg(nvl(d.total_defect_qty,0)),1) 불량수량 FROM plandata p LEFT OUTER JOIN workdata w ON p.prod_plan_date = w.PROD_PLAN_DATE LEFT OUTER JOIN defectdate d ON p.prod_plan_date = d.prod_plan_date GROUP BY to_char(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY 계획일자
